title: Simple Gated Experience Check-in
description: A lightweight check-in survey demonstrating on-device semantic question gating based on participant responses.

notification_prompt.title: Quick Check-in
notification_prompt.body: Take a moment to share how you are doing.

questions.prompt: In your own words, describe how you are feeling right now:

validation_rules.placeholder: e.g., feeling relaxed, overwhelmed with deadlines, tired...

questions.prompt: What is the primary factor contributing to this stress or tension?

gating_rule.natural_language_condition: The participant feels stressed or anxious.

questions.prompt: What coping strategy or support would be most helpful to you right now?

validation_rules.placeholder: e.g., taking a walk, stepping away from the screen, talking to a friend...

gating_rule.natural_language_condition: response expresses stress, anxiety, overwhelm, pressure, or emotional fatigue

questions.prompt: On a scale from 1 (completely drained) to 5 (fully energized), rate your current energy level:
